## Description {#details}

A class template for the intrusive list iterator.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">Type of object that includes the intrusive node.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="N">Type of intrusive node. Must have the public members <b>previous</b> &amp; <b>next</b>.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="MP">Name of the intrusive node member in object T.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="U">Type stored in the list, derived from T.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
This class provides an interface similar to <code>std::list::iterator</code>, except that it keeps track of the offset where the intrusive list element is located in the parent object.
